_comment: Per-environment bindings for the KM solution. Each teammate fills in their own connection IDs and values, so the same solution works in any environment. Generate a populated version with: pac solution create-settings --solution-zip out/KMKnowledgeAutomation.zip --settings-file power-platform/deployment-settings.json

EnvironmentVariables._note: Leave EMPTY in git. Set the value in the Power Platform environment after import, or inject it at deploy time. Never commit an API key.
Teams channel ID for the low-confidence review queue
Consecutive consistent classifications before a series OKR locks
Occurrences an action stays open before it is flagged stale
Local time My Assistant sends the daily brief

ConnectionReferences._note: Outlook — each person authorizes their own
